contactPage.heading: Contact
contactPage.intro: Find a Doc, Japan is a registered non-profit. Write to us when you need a person, not the search box.
contactPage.whatBody: Tell us about a clinic or doctor that should be listed, a correction to a page that is already up, or a problem using the site. We also answer questions from partners, journalists, and public offices about the organisation itself. We do not provide medical advice, diagnoses, or appointments. For care, use the directory to find a clinic and contact that clinic directly.
contactPage.npoBody: The registered name is NPO法人Find a Doc Japan, registration number 9011005010215, certified in Tokyo on 28 August 2023. Filed documents, including the balance sheet, are published on the NPO disclosures page. The registered office is a virtual office, so the street address is available on request rather than printed here.

about.heroSubheading: Connecting you to the healthcare services you need, in your language
about.storyParagraph1: Founded in 2020 during the pandemic by LaShawn Toyoda and Phil Ermish, our mission is to promote a healthier and more inclusive society. We offer quality health information for free in many languages for everyone, including foreigners and medical professionals. We aim for a Japan where all people, regardless of nationality or language, can confidently navigate the healthcare system, find the right doctors and get the healthcare they need.
about.storyParagraph2: We are a non-profit organization driven by the ideal that everyone should have access to health information as part of a flourishing life. Our activities are guided by a sense of social justice, cultural sensitivity and innovation. We are always happy to connect with partners in the governmental, non-profit and medical communities. Together with our partners, we hope to create a Japan where everyone has access to healthcare, feels included and can live well.
about.storyIncorporated: In August 2023 we were certified by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as a specified non-profit corporation (NPO法人).

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subheading: What we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with, and how to reach us about your information.

whoWeAre.heading: 1. Who we are
whoWeAre.p1: Find a Doc, Japan (NPO法人Find a Doc, Japan, a specified non-profit corporation in Tokyo, corporate number 9011005010215) runs findadoc.jp and the clinic pages on its subdomains. We handle personal information under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI).

collect.heading: 2. Information we collect
collect.p1: Searching the directory: you can search without an account. We receive your search terms, filters, and language. Your language, theme, and recent filters are saved in your own browser.
collect.p2: Suggesting a clinic or doctor: we receive what you enter, such as a Google Maps link, names, languages spoken, and notes. Please do not include your own health information.
collect.p3: Booking an appointment: when a clinic takes booking requests through Find a Doc, Japan, we collect what its form asks for. This can include your name, email address, phone number, age, the reason for your visit, the time you choose, and files such as a photo of you and of your health insurance card or eligibility certificate. Booking is offered only to people who are in Japan when they send the request.
collect.p4: The reason for your visit is health information, which the APPI treats as special care-required personal information. We collect it only when you submit the form yourself, after you tick a box consenting to us collecting it and passing it to the clinic you chose. We record when you gave that consent.
collect.p5: Accounts and technical information: moderators and clinic staff sign in through Auth0, which gives us their name, email address, and an account identifier. Our servers record IP addresses and request details to keep the service running and to prevent abuse.

use.heading: 3. How we use it
use.p1: We use this information to run the directory and keep it accurate, to pass your booking request to the clinic you chose, to email you about your request, to let clinic staff manage their bookings, to fix errors and prevent abuse, and, only if you accept cookies, to measure our advertising (section 6). We do not sell personal information, and we do not use it to personalise ads.

share.heading: 4. Who we share it with
share.p1: The clinic you book with receives your request, your answers, and your files, and handles them under its own obligations as a medical provider.
share.p2: Service providers run parts of the service for us and may use the information only to do so: Amazon Web Services (hosting, database, file storage, and email, in Tokyo), Auth0 by Okta (sign-in), Sentry (error reports, without names or email addresses), Umami (visit counts without cookies), Google Maps (the map on search results), and Google Ads and Google Analytics (only after you accept cookies).
share.p3: Google, Auth0, and Sentry may process information outside Japan, mainly in the United States. We choose providers that protect personal information to a standard equivalent to the APPI. Contact us for details about a provider and the country involved.
share.p4: We disclose personal information to others only with your consent, or when the law requires it.

retention.heading: 5. How long we keep it
retention.p1: Photos of insurance cards and other identity documents uploaded with a booking are deleted 30 days after upload. Other booking files are deleted after one year, and files from a booking that was never sent are deleted after 24 hours.
retention.p2: Booking answers and appointment records are kept while the clinic needs them and as long as needed to resolve disputes or meet legal obligations. Account information is kept while the account is active. You can ask us to delete your information sooner (section 8).

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies and advertising measurement
cookies.p1: We use Google Ads, and Google Analytics when it is enabled, provided by Google LLC, to measure how visitors reach and use our service. When you visit, your browser sends Google the page address, your IP address, browser details, and an identifier stored in a cookie. Google uses this to measure our ads. We do not use it to personalise ads for you. Google's privacy policy is at policies.google.com/privacy.
cookies.p2: We ask before loading any of these tools. Google Ads and Google Analytics send nothing to Google until you accept. You can accept or decline at any time with Cookie settings at the bottom of every page. If you decline, or later change your choice to decline, the tools are not loaded and their cookies are deleted.
cookies.p3: We also use cookies to remember your language and your cookie choice. Umami counts visits without cookies.

security.heading: 7. Security
security.p1: Information is encrypted in transit, and access is limited to the people who need it: our moderators, and the staff of the clinic you booked with. Clinic staff can see only their own clinic's bookings.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.p1: Under the APPI you can ask us to disclose the personal information we hold about you, to correct it, to stop using it, to delete it, or to stop sharing it with others. Email contact{'@'}findadoc.jp. We may first need to confirm who you are. You can also cancel a booking yourself with the private link in your confirmation email.

children.heading: 9. Children
children.p1: A parent or guardian should make bookings for a child. If you believe a child has given us personal information without a parent or guardian, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.p1: We post changes on this page and update the effective date. For significant changes, we also show a notice on the site.

gdpr.heading: 11. Visitors in the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland
gdpr.p1: If you use Find a Doc, Japan from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, the GDPR (or the UK GDPR or Swiss data protection law) also applies. Booking is offered only to people in Japan, so we do not take booking requests, or the health information in them, from those places. We rely on your consent for cookies and advertising measurement, and on our legitimate interests to run, secure, and fix the service.
gdpr.p2: You also have the right to receive your information in a portable format, to object to processing based on legitimate interests, to withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier processing, and to complain to your local data protection authority. Withdraw cookie consent with Cookie settings, and send other requests to contact{'@'}findadoc.jp.
gdpr.p3: The European Commission has decided that Japan protects personal information adequately, so information can be transferred from the EEA to Japan. Transfers to providers in the United States rely on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

contact.heading: 12. Contact
contact.p1: NPO法人Find a Doc, Japan · contact{'@'}findadoc.jp
